pages.title: Starlight Intelligence System — Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to SIS: what it is, why it exists, its ecosystem, key architectural principles, and a map to all child pages. Covers the 5-layer cognitive architecture, the session-amnesia problem it solves, and the Universal Context Standard.

pages.title: Getting Started & Installation
pages.purpose: Step-by-step guide for onboarding: installing the npm package, running `starlight init`, configuring `.starlight/profile.yml`, `stack.yml`, and `config.yml`, and generating the first context file. Covers Node.js ≥18 requirement, TypeScript/ESM build, and the `generate-context` script.

pages.title: FrankX Ecosystem Architecture
pages.purpose: Explains the three-repo vertically integrated stack: SIS (framework layer), ACOS (implementation layer), and Arcanea (universe layer). Covers downward context flow, upward knowledge accumulation, lateral transmission channels, and the architectural invariants that prevent drift.

pages.title: Core Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of the 5-layer cognitive stack and the 7-layer intelligence pipeline. Introduces the main TypeScript classes and how they interconnect. Links to child pages for each major subsystem.

pages.title: The 5-Layer Cognitive Stack
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the five layers: Layer 00 (IDENTITY/Luminor Constitution), Layer 01 (INTELLECT/Vaults), Layer 02 (PROTOCOL/Strategies), Layer 03 (AGENCY/Specialist Council), and Layer 04 (ARCANA/Guardian mythology). Explains how layers load in sequence during context generation.

pages.title: Intelligence Pipeline (7 Layers)
pages.purpose: Detailed walkthrough of the 7-stage processing pipeline: Perception → Memory Recall → Reasoning → Routing → Execution → Synthesis → Memory Write. Covers complexity scoring (1-10 scale), HIGH_COMPLEXITY_SIGNALS, pattern auto-selection, and the AgentExecution feedback loop.

pages.title: StarlightIntelligence Class & TypeScript SDK
pages.purpose: API reference for the main facade class: initialize(), orchestrate(), generateContext(), routeTask(), remember(), setExecutor(), save(). Covers StarlightOptions, AgentExecutor callback type, OrchestrationTask, and the modular export map from package.json.

pages.title: Memory & Vault System
pages.purpose: Overview of the persistent memory architecture: the six vaults, the MemoryManager class, VaultMemory, and the consolidation cascade. Links to child pages for vault specifications and the sync/guidance subsystems.

pages.title: The Six Vaults
pages.purpose: Specification for each vault: Strategic, Technical, Creative, Operational, Wisdom, and Horizon. Covers retention policies, access control matrix (which agents can read/write each vault), entry format (timestamp, category, confidence, source, related links), and health metrics.

pages.title: VaultMemory & MemoryManager
pages.purpose: Implementation details of the VaultMemory class (extends MemoryManager): rememberInVault(), searchVaults(), appendHorizon(), classifyVault() keyword engine, and the JSONL append-only horizon.jsonl ledger. Covers MemoryEntry schema, confidence scoring, and the memory.json persistence file.

pages.title: ACOS Sync & Trajectory Classification
pages.purpose: How ACOS trajectory files are imported into SIS memory via syncACOSToSIS(). Covers the classification engine (successScore thresholds for pattern/decision/insight/error/preference), deduplication via SyncState, minScore quality filtering, and the multi-project federated sync via ProjectRegistry.

pages.title: Behavioral Guidance & Intelligence Scoring
pages.purpose: Explains the Guidance Engine (src/guidance.ts): how trajectories are distilled into actionable behavioral rules (BehavioralRule, FailureLesson, DomainChecklist) injected as session-start markdown. Also covers the Intelligence Score system (0-100, four 25-point components: Memory Depth, Pattern Quality, Operational History, Learning Velocity) and the IntelligenceReport output.

pages.title: Agent Council
pages.purpose: Overview of the flat council with emergent leadership model, the three tiers (Leadership, Specialist, Foundation), and how council mode activates for complexity 9-10 tasks. Links to child pages for individual agent profiles and the routing/orchestration system.

pages.title: The Seven Starlight Agents
pages.purpose: Profile of each council agent: Orchestrator (coordination), Prime (synthesis), Architect (enterprise systems), Navigator (strategy), Sentinel (quality/security), Weaver (creative), and Sage (wisdom/vault guardian). Covers domain expertise, reasoning protocols, vault access permissions, and transmission channel access for each.

pages.title: Routing Matrix & Orchestration Patterns
pages.purpose: How the Routing Matrix dispatches tasks via keyword/intent matching and complexity scoring (P0-P3 priority, 5-level escalation). Covers the six orchestration patterns (Direct, Sequential, Parallel, Iterative, Cascade, Broadcast) and the three synthesis strategies (Weighted-Consensus, Sequential-Refinement, Conflict-Resolution).

pages.title: Arcana Layer & Guardian Mapping
pages.purpose: The optional Layer 04: the 10 Guardians of Arcanea mapped to SIS council agents, frequency-to-complexity model allocation (Gemini Pro/Flash vs Claude Opus), elemental routing logic, persona communication signatures, and the GUARDIAN_MODELS configuration. Explains how mythology IS the architecture.

pages.title: Skill System
pages.purpose: Overview of the 16-skill, 4-category architecture and the auto-activation system driven by skill-rules.json. Links to child pages for each skill category and the composition patterns.

pages.title: Skill Categories & Auto-Activation
pages.purpose: The four skill categories (Intelligence, Orchestration, Memory, Integration) with their 16 skills. Covers the four-priority auto-activation system (Exact Match → Keyword Match → Agent Default → Context Inference), token budget strategy (metadata/summary/core/full levels), and skill composition patterns (Sequential, Parallel, Nested, Conditional).

pages.title: Intelligence & Orchestration Skills
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the 8 skills in the Intelligence and Orchestration categories: Strategic Reasoning, Systems Thinking, Pattern Recognition, Decision Framework, Multi-Agent Coordination, Workflow Design, Context Engineering, and Parallel Execution. Covers trigger conditions, procedures, and integration points.

pages.title: Memory & Integration Skills
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the 8 skills in the Memory and Integration categories: Vault Management, Knowledge Synthesis, Context Preservation, Memory Consolidation, Repo Bridge, Ecosystem Sync, Transmission Protocol, and Universal Adapter. Covers how these skills connect to vaults, transmissions, and external systems.

pages.title: CLI Reference
pages.purpose: Overview of the `starlight` CLI binary and its command groups. Links to child pages for each command group. Covers the zero-dependency parseArgs architecture and the .starlight/ configuration directory lifecycle.

pages.title: Core CLI Commands
pages.purpose: Reference for init, generate, guidance, sync, score, and orchestrate commands. Covers flags, output formats, the context generation pipeline (config.yml → layers → maxTokens → output file), and the orchestrate JSON output format.

pages.title: Vault & Project CLI Commands
pages.purpose: Reference for the `vault` subcommand suite (list, get, set, search) and the `project` subcommand suite (register, list, sync-all). Covers the ProjectRegistry (.starlight/projects.json), federated multi-sync across repos, and vault key-value operations.

pages.title: Slash Commands (Agent Interface)
pages.purpose: The six slash commands available within AI agent sessions: /starlight (system control), /vault (memory operations), /transmit (cross-system communication), /synthesize (multi-source synthesis), /council (agent council convening), and /navigate (strategic planning). Covers command processing flow and lifecycle hooks.

pages.title: Platform Adapters
pages.purpose: Overview of the six platform adapters and the principle of 'same intelligence, different envelope.' Links to child pages for IDE/CLI adapters and the context engine that drives generation.

pages.title: IDE & CLI Platform Adapters
pages.purpose: Configuration details for all six adapters: Claude Code (CLAUDE.md, MCP, hooks), Cursor (.cursor/rules/*.mdc with MDC frontmatter and glob scoping), Cline (.clinerules/, Memory Bank compatibility), Codex (AGENTS.md cascading), Gemini CLI (.gemini/GEMINI.md), and Antigravity (.antigravity/instructions.md with browser control).

pages.title: Context Engine
pages.purpose: How the ContextEngine class assembles optimized system prompts from the 5 layers (identity, knowledge, strategy, agents, memory). Covers DEFAULT_PROFILE/DEFAULT_STACK/DEFAULT_BRAND fallbacks, maxTokens enforcement, the setMemories() injection of the 20 most recent MemoryManager entries, and the GeneratedContext output object.

pages.title: Transmissions & Integrations
pages.purpose: Overview of the cross-system communication protocol and external integrations. Links to child pages for the transmission system and MCP/infrastructure integrations.

pages.title: Transmission Protocol
pages.purpose: The four transmission channels (ACOS, Arcanea, AI-Ops, Broadcast), transmission format (sender, priority, content, acknowledgment), priority levels (Critical/High/Normal/Low), send/receive/sync flows, and the rule that only Prime can authorize broadcast transmissions. Covers how transmissions log to the Operational Vault.

pages.title: MCP & Infrastructure Integrations
pages.purpose: The six MCP servers (filesystem, github, web-search, browser, memory) and their lazy-loading activation strategy. Optional infrastructure integrations via AI-Ops: LiteLLM gateway, Langfuse observability, Qdrant vector search, PostgreSQL, Neo4j/FalkorDB knowledge graphs, and n8n workflow orchestration. Covers standalone vs enhanced mode.
